name: The Hazelton Hotel
positioning: Independent luxury hotel in the heart of Toronto's Yorkville, with balconied rooms, the Spa by Valmont, ONE Restaurant and a private screening cinema
best_for: Travelers who want a Yorkville base in Toronto
Guests who want a spa with an indoor saltwater pool
Guests travelling with a cat or dog

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Yorkville.
Rooms and suites have Juliet or walk-out balconies.
ONE Restaurant's seasonal menu uses local and international ingredients to create globally inspired dishes.
Rooms have L'Occitane bath products, a Nespresso coffee maker and a pillow menu.
The Deluxe King Accessible Room has a roll-in shower with a grab bar and a built-in retractable seat.
The Luxury Two Queen Room accommodates up to four guests, with interconnecting room options available.
Baby cribs can be booked free of charge, subject to availability.
The hotel welcomes cats and dogs as guests.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and offers the Leaders Club loyalty program.
The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge who can arrange airport transfers.
Wi-Fi in the hotel rooms is free of charge.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private 25-seat cinema, the Norman Jewison Cinema, with DCP capabilities.
The Spa by Valmont has an indoor saltwater pool, steam rooms and a fitness centre.
A Macallan Bar Cart service, in partnership with The Macallan, offers cocktails and rare whisky pours prepared tableside or in-room by mixologists.
The Bellair Suite has a private walk-out balcony with views of Yorkville, a dining area for up to 10 guests, a pantry and a private bar.
Rooms feature original artwork alongside Galaxy Green granite bathrooms with deep soaking tubs and rainfall showers.

considerations.text: Valet parking only takes vehicles under 6.6 feet (2 meters); other vehicles must self-park offsite.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site recreational facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
